snippet.title: Outsail The Sun Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Outsail The Sun and sign up for the playtest:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4023510/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=rockpocket&utm_campaign=steamlaunch&utm_content=trailer
Discord - https://discord.gg/Dz4Nk9KRqp

Conquer dark oceans as the captain of a vampirate crew. Feast on sailor blood for roguelite-style upgrades, fend off mighty sea creatures with your overpowered builds, go treasure hunting, and outsail the sun to achieve bullet-heaven under the night sky!

Features:
- A ship-based bullet-heaven with both manual and auto-battle elements.
- A wide range of gunner sailors and support sailors, offering different synergies.
- Campaigns targeting a 30-45 minute playtime with a high focus on exploration, treasure hunting and climactic boss fights.
- Unlock and choose between different captains and ships catering themselves to different playstyles.
- Original Soundtrack by The Noble Demon (Nightmare Kart)

#gamedev #hordesurvival #indiegame #games
